title: Frame
summary: The basic rectangular GUI container: colored box for panels, cards, and layout groups. Combined with UIListLayout/UIGridLayout for automatic arrangement of children.

properties.name: Size / Position
properties.description: Size/pos as Scale (fraction of parent) + Offset (pixels). UDim2.fromScale/fromOffset helpers.

properties.name: AnchorPoint
properties.description: Which point of the frame Position refers to. (0.5, 0.5) = centered.

properties.name: ClipsDescendants
properties.description: Crop children to this frame's bounds — scroll areas, rounded corners.

details.heading: Layout companions
details.body: UIListLayout (rows/columns), UIGridLayout (grids), UIPadding (insets), UICorner (rounded), UIStroke (border), UIScale — parented INSIDE the Frame to affect it/its children.

explanation.whatItIs: A box you put other UI in — the HTML <div> of Roblox GUIs.
explanation.whyItExists: Every interface is boxes within boxes; Frame is the plain box.
whenToUse: Panels, cards, windows, health bars, inventory grids
Grouping elements for show/hide (Visible on the parent)
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
Frame (the box)
 ├─ Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.5)   → 30% wide, 50% tall
 ├─ AnchorPoint = (0.5, 0.5) + Position (0.5, 0.5) → centered
 ├─ UIListLayout → children stack automatically
 └─ children…
```
tips: Prefer Scale sizes for responsive UI; Offset for pixel-precise bits
AnchorPoint 0.5/0.5 + Position 0.5/0.5 = dead center, any resolution
commonMistakes: Designing only in Offset pixels — UI breaks on other resolutions
Forgetting AnchorPoint when centering (Position alone anchors top-left)
Nested frames with BackgroundTransparency 0 everywhere → invisible UI confusion

examples.title: A centered card
examples.code:
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 200)
frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)   -- center of screen
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
frame.Parent = script.Parent

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = frame

local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
list.Parent = frame
